headline: Sensex Ends Marginally Lower While Nifty Holds Above 23,250 Level
why: Realty and pharma sectors surged over 1.5 percent, offering support to benchmark indices.
IT sector dragged the market ahead of the crucial US Federal Reserve policy decision.
Global cues remained mixed with US mortgage rates touching 7 percent and Asian signals.
whatHappening: Indian market indices held steady with Nifty staying above the 23,250 level.
Government launched the 16th round of commercial auctions offering 25 coal blocks.
Lam Research announced a ₹10,000 crore investment to expand its manufacturing footprint in India.
SEBI barred promoters of Kore Digital over an alleged ₹541 crore revenue misstatement.

stocksInNews.sources: Oil India plans to spend ₹15,000 crore for deepwater exploration over three years
Sebi bars Kore Digital promoters over alleged Rs 541 crore revenue misstatement
Paytm to be in focus during today's market session

summary: Indian benchmark indices closed flat with Nifty holding above 23,250, supported by strong gains in pharma and realty against IT drags. Major corporate highlights included massive capex commitments from Oil India and Lam Research alongside SEBI regulatory action.
